text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¡Bueno! And here comes the suuuuplex!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: El-chan? What're you watching~?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Akebono! It's a pro-wrestling match
from last week, deee-su!

text_block_list.name: Wrestling Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, Kinboshi delivers an open-hand strike from both sides!
Followed immediately by a swift lariaaaat!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I know that wrestler! He's a former sumo wrestler, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, was that an inside leg trip just now?!
Fight on, fight oooon!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Are you interested in Kinboshi?!
Actually, he has an upcoming match, desu!!
You simply must come watch it with me!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Sounds fun~! Yeah, let's go together, let's go, let's go~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One holiday afternoon, I spotted Hishi Akebono
and El Condor Pasa watching a pro-wrestling show
at an outdoor amusement park stage.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! He flew so high off the corner turnbuckle!
That's got a whole different kind of punch compared to sumo~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The acrobatic techniques are part of pro-wrestling's charm, desu!
You can't look away even for a single second, desu yo~!

text_block_list.name: Wrestling Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Kinboshi lands a horizontal chop straight to the chest!
However, the opponent takes it calmly
and counters with a chop of his own!

text_block_list.name: Wrestling Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Chop! He takes it! Chop! Taken again!
A fierce clash of flesh and bone as they trade heavy blows!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, both their chests are bright red!
But why aren't they dodging?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Because there is an 'aesthetics of endurance,' desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The fortitude to take moves head-on!
The skill and power to bounce back from adversity!
That is true 'strength' in pro-wrestling, desu!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see~! Taking your opponent's attacks head-on and returning them with dignity...!
That's just like yokozuna-style sumo~!

text_block_list.name: Wrestling Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a backdrop suplex connects!
Kinboshi is flat on the canvas!
Can he still fight back, folks?!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: Kin-bo-shi!! Kin-bo-shi!!

text_block_list.name: Wrestling Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Clapping and chants for Kinboshi erupt from the crowd!
Now, what will Kinboshi do?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Whoa!! What amazing cheering...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The wrestlers hype up the ring,
and the audience hypes them up with chants!
This is the true essence of pro-wrestling, desu!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hyping it up together... I get it!
Pro-wrestling is just like a hearty chanko nabe
packed with everyone's warm feelings!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The wrestlers, the crowd, eveeeeryone
wants to make this match great!
Alright, count me in too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Kin-bo-shi!! Kin-bo-shi!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¡Bueno! El won't be outdone either!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Kin-bo-shi!! Kin-bo-shi!!

text_block_list.name: Wrestling Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, Kinboshi gets back on his feet!
Turning the fans' cheers into pure power!
Off the ropes—and a dropkiiiick!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: WAAAAHHH--!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ that was so fun~!
Thanks to you today, El-chan,
I got to learn just how fun pro-wrestling is♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Same here! I'm super happy that
you got to experience the magic of pro-wrestling, desu!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! It kinda feels like
we're sharing a big portion of fun with each other~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Sí! By the way, there's another match next week,
what do you say, desu ka?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking completely thrilled, Hishi Akebono
began making plans with El Condor Pasa
to attend the next match.
